node.title: KoalaBear m2 r4 diagonal c2 square-fiber linear cut
node.closure: exact rank-four unramified and rank-two ramified coefficient cuts from the saturated c2 square fiber
node.statement: In the source-line branch of every saturated c=2 diagonal row, the forced square fiber has an exact ramification dichotomy. At an unramified source orbit, both U(T,w) and V(T,w) lie in the line spanned by the printed endpoint quadratic P_J1; these four independent linear conditions cut the reciprocal source spaces from dimensions 8/7 to 4/3, and all three coefficient minors share the reciprocal source-orbit quadratic with explicit linear quotients. At the ramified orbit {0,infinity}, only the relevant value of U is constrained, giving rank two and dimensions 6/5. This is a linear reduction, not a branch or row deletion.
